<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak (211 → 213), which matches the characteristic 3:1 isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). Additionally, there is a smaller peak around +3 Da (214) with ~4 % intensity, consistent with the natural abundance of 34S (≈4 %). These patterns are distinctive enough to definitively identify chlorine and sulfur in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl', 'S']</final_answer>
